subject: Incident evidence export and short-term retention plan
messages:
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acme-corp.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence retention and export after June 24 incident

Hi Alex / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick response last week. Our security team has asked for a formal preservation and export of logs and related artifacts tied to the June 24th service disruption while we complete our internal review. They specifically asked for: 

- All application-level request/response logs for the impacted workspace for the window 2027-06-24 00:00 - 2027-06-25 23:59 UTC
- Any available gateway/edge access logs for the same interval
- KV/cache snapshots, if you keep them for that tenant, and an overview of cache retention semantics

Can you confirm the retention timeline you propose for these artifacts, the export format (CSV/JSON/PCAP where applicable), and whether anything will be retained outside the US region? Procurement is copied for paperwork. We may request a signed chain-of-custody form before transfer.

Appreciate a short plan and timeline today if possible.

Regards,
Alice Jones
Head of Security Operations
Acme Manufacturing

Attachments: none

From: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence retention and export after June 24 incident

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. I'm looping in Marissa from Security Ops to own the preservation and chain-of-custody workflow; Ben is on-deck for procurement/transfer logistics. High level plan below, happy to hop on a call.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Place a preservation hold on the requested artifacts for 90 days starting 2027-06-29 (we typically preserve incident windows for 90 days by default unless longer retention is contractually required).
2) Prepare exports as compressed JSON bundles (application logs and edge logs) and CSV for summarized request metrics. KV/cache snapshots will be delivered as a gzipped JSON blob along with a manifest.
3) Data residency: exports will be from the US-EAST1 region (no cross-region copies), unless you request otherwise in writing.
4) Chain-of-custody: we can sign your procurement-approved form or use the attached forensic_manifest_template.csv to enumerate files, hashes, and timestamps before transfer.

Estimated timeline: preservation hold in place within 2 hours; exports prepared within 48 hours once we receive a signed COC (or confirmation to proceed). Secure transfer via our SFTP + audit link (see Marissa's note and the secure link I'll generate).

Questions for you:
- Do you want us to include raw tracing spans or only request/response payload metadata?
- Any PII redaction requirements we should apply before export?

Attaching: forensic_manifest_template.csv (template for the file manifest we will populate).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: forensic_manifest_template.csv (CSV template for manifest)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Alice Jones <alice.jones@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence retention and export after June 24 incident

Adding a quick procurement note — we will need a signed transfer agreement and an SOW for any engineering time beyond the baseline export (our standard T&Cs cover up to 4 hours of engineering to assemble exports; anything beyond that we bill to a short SOW).

Alex / Marissa — can you estimate the engineering hours for a full raw export (including KV snapshots and traces) vs. a summarized export? I'll loop in Legal if we need deviation from standard terms.

Thanks — will follow up with procurement next steps.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acme-corp.com>, alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence retention and export after June 24 incident

Hi Alice — Marissa here (Security Ops). Confirming that we've implemented the preservation hold for the June 24 window as of 2027-06-29 13:05 PDT. Below is the formal handling plan and the materials we'll need from you to move to transfer.

Preservation and handling plan
- Hold period: 90 days (will not be auto-deleted during this period). If Acme requests extension, please notify us with justification and the account owner will approve.
- Export format: primary exports will be gzipped JSON for raw logs, CSV for aggregated metrics, and a manifest (CSV) containing file name, SHA256, size, and UTC timestamp.
- Residency: Exports and preserved copies will remain in US-EAST1. No copies will be stored in EU/APAC unless explicitly requested and approved in writing.
- Chain-of-custody: Before transfer we will produce the manifest and a signed custody log (PDF). Each file will have SHA256 hashes; we will document the transfer session (SFTP token + transfer start/end) and provide MD5/SHA verification.
- Access controls: Only designated Acme contacts (Alice Jones and procurement@acme-corp.com) will be granted access to the transfer URL. Transfers are logged and will be retained for audit.

Required from Acme before transfer
- Signed preservation/transfer agreement (we can use your COC or sign our standard form)
- Confirmation of whether PII should be redacted or provided raw (legal sign-off)
- Point of contact and PGP key (optional) if you want encrypted assets at rest

Estimated engineering effort
- Summarized export (CSV + manifests): ~2 engineer-hours (no charge if within standard incident assistance)
- Full raw export (gzipped JSON + KV snapshots + traces): ~6–10 engineer-hours (may require an SOW if beyond standard allowance)

Planned transfer method
- Secure transfer link will be generated through our secure endpoint: https://redwood.example.com/s/secure-transfer/txn/9a7b6c
- We will upload the bundle and notify you; you will have 7 days to download after notification.

Next steps (action items)
- Alice: confirm redaction preference and provide signed COC or tell us to proceed with Redwood form.
- Procurement: confirm who signs the transfer agreement and routing for any SOW.
- Alex/Ben: prepare SOW estimate if Acme wants raw export.

I've attached our chain_of_custody_instructions.pdf and a draft preservation agreement for your legal to review. If you'd like a short call to finalize, I'm available today at 4pm PT.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: chain_of_custody_instructions.pdf, preservation_agreement-draft.docx
